camel_example: aliyun cas ListInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status inactive --Brand Digicert --CertificateType DV --Keyword test --ResourceGroupId 'rg-ae0000004wia' --CurrentPage 1 --CertificateStatus issued --ShowSize 10 --InstanceType BUY
kebab_example: aliyun cas list-instances --keyword test --status inactive --brand Digicert --certificate-type DV --certificate-status issued --instance-type BUY --resource-group-id rg-ae0000004wia --show-size 10 --current-page 1 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy search. Matches domain names, instance names, or corresponding resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 模糊查询，匹配域名、名称实例或对应的资源ID
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
inactive: Pending use.
pending: Under review. The latest certificate is being reviewed.
willExpire: About to expire.
expired: Expired.
refund: Refunded.
normal: Normal.
closed: Closed and unavailable
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。
inactive：待使用
pending：审核中，最新证书提交审核中
willExpire：实例即将过期
expired：实例已经过期
refund：已退款
normal：正常
closed：已关闭，不可使用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The CA brand. Valid values: WoSign, CFCA, DigiCert, GeoTrust, GlobalSign, vTrus, and Alibaba
parameters.name: brand

parameters.help_en: The type of the certificate. Valid values: DV, OV, and EV
parameters.name: certificate_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:
issued: Issued.
revoked: Revoked.
willExpire: About to expire.
expired: Expired
parameters.help_zh:
证书的状态。
issued：已签发
revoked：已吊销
willExpire：即将过期
expired：已过期
parameters.name: certificate_status

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
BUY: official certificate.
TEST: test certificate
parameters.help_zh: 实例类型，BUY：正式证书；TEST：测试证书
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to display per page in a paged query. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页显示实例的数量。默认值为10，最大为100
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page
